body: Tanushree Bagrodia (Director & Group CEO) on the Q4FY26 call (2026-05-26), prompted: "As far as tariffs are concerned, we are P&L neutral" Metric: Tariff impact on FY26 P&L. Target: Neutral. Deadline: 2026-03-31 (fiscal-year). Specificity: precise. Status as of 2026-11-19: DELIVERED. Evidence: Restatement of the May-2025 promise; FY26 OPM rose to 21%. Management-only evidence; FX inventory gains (~2% of material cost in Q2 and Q4) help mask any leakage.
